name: last-train.fdx
text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no" ?>
<FinalDraft DocumentType="Script" Template="No" Version="5">
  <Content>
    <Paragraph Type="Scene Heading" Number="1">
      <SceneProperties Length="1" Page="1" Title="">
        <Summary>
          <Paragraph Alignment="Left"><Text>Mara misses the last train and meets Leo.</Text></Paragraph>
        </Summary>
      </SceneProperties>
      <Text>EXT. CENTRAL STATION - NIGHT</Text>
    </Paragraph>
    <Paragraph Type="Action">
      <Text>Rain hammers the glass roof. </Text><Text Style="Bold">MARA</Text><Text> runs across the empty concourse.</Text>
    </Paragraph>
    <Paragraph Type="Character"><Text>MARA</Text></Paragraph>
    <Paragraph Type="Parenthetical"><Text>(out of breath)</Text></Paragraph>
    <Paragraph Type="Dialogue"><Text>No. No, no, no.</Text></Paragraph>
    <Paragraph Type="Character"><Text>LEO (O.S.)</Text></Paragraph>
    <Paragraph Type="Dialogue"><Text>It left four minutes early.</Text></Paragraph>
    <Paragraph Type="Shot"><Text>CLOSE ON THE DEPARTURES BOARD</Text></Paragraph>
    <Paragraph Type="Transition"><Text>CUT TO:</Text></Paragraph>
    <Paragraph Type="Scene Heading" Number="2">
      <Text>INT. GUARD BOOTH - CONTINUOUS</Text>
    </Paragraph>
    <Paragraph Type="Action"><Text>A tiny room: a heater, a radio, a chessboard mid-game.</Text></Paragraph>
    <Paragraph>
      <DualDialogue>
        <Paragraph Type="Character"><Text>MARA</Text></Paragraph>
        <Paragraph Type="Dialogue"><Text>Is there a bus?</Text></Paragraph>
        <Paragraph Type="Character"><Text>LEO</Text></Paragraph>
        <Paragraph Type="Dialogue"><Text>There is me, and there is tea.</Text></Paragraph>
      </DualDialogue>
    </Paragraph>
    <Paragraph Type="Scene Heading" Number="3">
      <Text>EXT. PLATFORM 4 - DAWN</Text>
    </Paragraph>
    <Paragraph Type="Action"><Text>The first train glides in, empty and gold in the low sun.</Text></Paragraph>
  </Content>
  <TitlePage>
    <Content>
      <Paragraph Alignment="Center"><Text>LAST TRAIN</Text></Paragraph>
      <Paragraph Alignment="Center"><Text>written by</Text></Paragraph>
      <Paragraph Alignment="Center"><Text>Nora Vidal</Text></Paragraph>
    </Content>
  </TitlePage>
</FinalDraft>
